tools.name: land_at
tools.description: Use when someone asks what they can do with a specific property or address in Austin, TX or Nashville, TN: what it is zoned and what that means, how many homes the lot can take (Austin HOME rules, Texas SB 840 apartments on commercial land), what the zoning ordinance or Nashville Specific Plan says,

tools.name: find_land
tools.description: Use when someone wants to find land or lots in Austin or Nashville that fit a need, for example lots where three homes are allowed, commercial land where apartments are allowed without a rezoning, dry industrial land of 5+ acres, zoning where whole-home short-term rentals are permitted, or Specific

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Use when someone wants a list of local businesses in Central Austin, TX by kind (for example dentists, coffee shops, plumbers), optionally only ones with no website listed or with a phone or email. Returns name, category, address, website status and contact details, each linked to its source record.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: land_at, search_businesses · Public sink: search_businesses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: land_at, search_businesses · Public sink: search_businesses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "land_at" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when someone asks what they can do with a specific property or address in Austin, TX or Nashville, TN: what it is zoned and what that means, how many homes the lot can take (Austin HOME rules, Texas SB 840 apartments on commercial land), what the zoning ordinance or Nashville Specific Plan says," → after: "Use when someone asks what they can do with a specific property or address in Austin, TX or Nashville, TN: what it is zoned and what that means, how many homes the lot can take (Austin HOME rules, Texas SB 840 apartments on commercial land), what the zoning ordinance or Nashville Specific Plan says,"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
